cockpit.target: 一跨 OS 今日驾驶舱
cockpit.blockedBehaviour: When verification is not VERIFIED the projection is BLOCKED and every value is null; gaps and investigation priorities remain visible.
acceptance: Projection never mutates business state and reports formalTaskWrites=0, workflowExecutions=0.
Unverified facts never surface as numbers in the cockpit.
Priority order is preserved from the archived report; the cockpit cannot re-rank or create tasks.
A BLOCKED projection still explains which verification check failed.

acceptanceCriteria: Default configuration keeps every real gate closed: contract DRAFT, policy DRAFT, mapping UNVERIFIED, reviewer registry empty.
The synthetic G2-B0 path remains byte-compatible and its 34 tests still pass.
A real context is only produced when all 15 verification checks pass.
Real reports reuse the G2-B0 archive, trace and Human correction path unchanged.
Test-only contracts and policies are usable only inside a marked isolated fixture root.
Verification receipts, contract/policy/mapping hashes are archived with the report for replay.
